name: No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger
description:
In the distant past, a great battle known as the "Universe War" erupted between all Super Sentai robots and a colossal "Calamity." This war, later called the "Universal Great War," was brought to an end by a giant deity named Tega Sword. This transcendent being, imbued with the power of all Super Sentai, fell into slumber after sustaining injuries.

Hoeru Tono, a young man drifting between part-time jobs, finds himself fired once again. Around the same time, the mysterious organization "Bridan" begins attacking Earth to awaken Tega Sword. Suddenly, Hoeru is enveloped in a strange space where he encounters Tega Sword. He learns that gathering special "rings" will grant him any wish. Without a specific wish in mind, Hoeru resolves to aim for the "Number One" and fights as Gozyu Wolf against Bridan. What wish will Hoeru eventually discover? And who are the other ring warriors?

videos.title: Super Sentai Universe War ~No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger Episode 0~
videos.overview: The Universe War, an event that pitted the Giants of the various universes against "The Calamity", a being hellbent on bringing nothing but ruination to the world and the awakening of the Super Sentai's final Giant...

videos.title: Savior No. 1!
videos.overview: No friends, no money, no amiability. Hoeru Tono is an outcast from society who spends his days as a wandering part-time worker. One day, he and his co-worker Tsutsumi encounter an attack by a giant robot in the city.

videos.title: Catch the Treasure! It's My Prey
videos.overview: Hoeru has made a contract with Tega Sword and become Gozyu Wolf. He finds out that his colleague Tsutsumi is also a Ring Warrior, and the two begin fighting - And then, more Ring Warriors appear.

videos.title: The Don of Japan! I'm the Prime Minister!
videos.overview: Hoeru discovers that the Prime Minister of Japan, Tokonatsu Atami, is also one of the ring bearers, who can transform into Don Momotaro. While thinking on how to defeat him, he is approached by a mysterious woman called Sumino Ichikawa.

videos.title: Party Time ☆ The Dreaming Geezer
videos.overview: The 4th Gozyuger, an old man, seeks to relive his youth.

videos.title: Recover Your Soul! Don't Let Your Troubles Get in the Way
videos.overview: Sumino, the 5th Gozyuger, made contract with Tega Sword to fulfill her wish to get revenge for the person that kidnapped her young sister, Oto. But she can't even engage?

videos.title: Final Battle! The Great Adventure of Tokonatsu Castle
videos.overview: After being fired from prime minister, Tokonatsu teaming up with Buraidan and challenging Hoeru and others for a ring battle. The greatest showdown take place in the magnificent Tokonatsu Castle, which Tokonatsu true wish lies behind that.

videos.title: Heart-Pounding! The Gozyugers Unite!
videos.overview: A mysterious man name Meguru Osai that call himself a "Sentai Archeologist" appear in front Hoeru, Ryugi and Kinjiro. They been given certain missions which if they succeed, he will give them his Sentai Rings.

videos.title: Between Right and Wrong, the Ring Hunter
Unbreakable Wolf
videos.overview: Hoeru left the Gozyugers and now become an outcast again. He starts working at a cafe as a new place he belong. In other side, Kuon visit the Tega Sword Village and met the other four. What's he planning?

videos.title: Go, Go, Go! Showa Has Arrived!
videos.overview: Showa No.1 have appeared and turn the whole town to Showa era. He in rampage and doesn't accept the year 2025, forcing Sumino and Kinjiro to join his No.1 Battle. In other side, Osai have returned, but why does he attacking Gozyugers?

videos.title: Unleash the Wild! The Beastmaster Plays His Flute
videos.overview: Gaia Todoroki, the Wandering Beast Master have appear in front of Gozyugers. He is another ring warrior under the power of Gao Red.

videos.title: The Evil Demon Roars!!
videos.overview: A new No.1 monster emerges from the defeated Onigokko No.1, known as "One-Horned Beast". Gaia was in shocked and fight against him with anger. How was his past and what is his true wish behind this?

videos.title: Housekeeper Run! Ryugi's Manners
videos.overview: A new universe warrior have appear, which is the Red Racer. More shockingly, her identity is Ryugi's maid that want to take back Ryugi to his parent house.

videos.title: The Sacred Servant, the Legend of Tega Sword!
videos.overview: Shoko turned into the Rampaging Red Racer after too much worries about Ryugi. But behind that, there was unforgettable childhood memories between them. In other side, Ryugi try to recall back how he encounter the Legendary Tega Sword.

videos.title: Stop The June Bride
videos.overview: Queen Tega June finally begins her move. Bridan now busy in preparing the marriage for Tega June with Tega Sword. Tega Sword strongly warn the Gozyugers that if this marriage really happen, it will bring the end of the world.

videos.title: True Savior No. 1!
videos.overview: As the world end is coming, a "True Savior" come and prevent it. He is a new ring warrior, Gozyu Polar under the name Mashiro Kumade. Meanwhile, the Gozyugers turn into their normal life again, but something is different now.

videos.title: Shine Brightly! No.1 Sports Day!
videos.overview: The Sports Day has begun. But suddenly a new No.1 monster at Sport Days appear. Gozyugers join the No.1 battle against the monster, alongside with Mashiro and also Aoi.

videos.title: Mystery GP! The Detective Is in the Village
videos.overview: A No.1 Monster appear in Tega Sword Village. He challenging the Gozyugers for a battle of mystery title "Tega Sword Village: Locked Room Murder Case". Sumino is the one leading this battle as she is a high-class luxury detective.

videos.title: WhiteBurn with Two Hearts!
videos.overview: Hoeru having an encounter with Mine which he met before when lost in No One World. Mine asking Hoeru for a dating. Meanwhile, Universe Daizyuzin appears again. Hoeru and Mashiro combine they power and a new Tega Sword formation is born.

videos.title: Serious About Gyaru! Oto is a Weird Character!?
videos.overview: Oto, Sumino long lost youngest sister finally returned!? What more shockingly, she was one of the ring warrior with the power of Shinken Red. But, Sumino noticed that Oto now is very different from what she know.

videos.title: Burning Festival Spirit! TegaSword SUMMER!
videos.overview: Fire Candle take force Shinkenger Ring from Oto then become the second universe warrior Shinken Red. To calm down the situation, the Gozyugers go to a Summer Festival. But there, No.1 Festival monster appear and control the festival.

videos.title: Is It a Good Deal? Is It a Hassle? This Is How You Save Money!
videos.overview: Hoeru was lack of money. Knowing a No.1 Monster of money saving appears, Hoeru join the No.1 battle against him to show his skill in saving. Meanwhile, Rikuo was approached by a person that he really know and was looking for, Rei.

videos.title: The Lonely Supernova, Awakened Wolf!
videos.overview: Rikuo betrayed the Gozyugers!? Meanwhile Fire Candle access a new power using a weapon called Orca Booster. The power is so dangerous, so the other Gozyugers was planning on capturing it.

videos.title: The Thief The Academy's All Been Talking About
videos.overview: Sumino got a request to investigate a school where the students never returns to the home. The Gozyugers go to the school. They found out that the school was protected by someone who also a ring warrior, Ikki Haruwatari as Patren 1gou.

videos.title: The Gutsy Police Are in the Clear!
videos.overview: After the defeat of Youth No.1, Gutsiness No.1 suddenly appears and turned the Keikai Academy into a prison. Ikki realize all what happened in cause by him. Will the peace returned to the academy?

videos.title: Close to the Secret! Hoeru Tono is a New Employee
videos.overview: Hoeru, a part-timer who have been unemployment being appointed as a new employee of the Toei Company. He decided to make an interview with the Gozyugers.

videos.title: Win the Battle! Get Rich Quick!
videos.overview: Kumade discovered Bouquet was amnesiac and decide to take care of her. Meanwhile, Kuon send a invitation to the other Gozyugers to come to his company. They were taken for a walk around the company by Arata, the company No. 2 person.

videos.title: Dancing with Love! This is my AI
videos.overview: Setsuna trapped the Five Gozyugers. All of them fall into an imaginary dream except of Hoeru. Bouquet also being captured as a research subject. Will she able to regain back her memories and her real love?

videos.title: The Ultimate Hospitality! Ryugi is Serious!
videos.overview: After witnessing Tega Sword's defeat at the hands of Pestis, Ryugi finds both his faith and his resolve shaken. Meanwhile, Hospitality No.1 starts causing trouble in town...

videos.title: Noble and Powerful! The New Tyranno is a Prince
videos.overview:
The second GozyuTyranno, who took Ryugi's missing ring in his hand, is Prince Assam, who came from the self-proclaimed "Tea Planet"! The Gozyugers find out and get caught up in all kinds of trouble caused by Assam...!?

Meanwhile, Mochitsuki No.1 has started a hellish mochi-pounding competition! Hoeru tries his best to make the best rice cakes in the No.1 Battle, but Assam...!?

videos.title: I Am Tyranno! The Will to Save the World
videos.overview:
Hoeru suddenly falls ill and is admitted to the Bakugami Hospital run by Ryugi's father, Ryuto. At the hospital, the Gozyugers run into Ryugi who had disappeared, and Hoeru is happy to see him again. However, Ryugi has followed in his father's footsteps and has become a completely different person....

Meanwhile, Doctor No.1 appears at the Bakugami Hospital! Doctor No.1 is about to start a surgery, but the Gozyugers...!? Rei, who has the GozyuTyranno ring, also arrives...!?

videos.title: A Sudden Breakup!? A Big Fight Between Knife and Cake
videos.overview:
Mr. Shining Knife & Mrs. Sweet Cake, who are always in love with each other, have a fight and say they are breaking up! However, Knife & Cake, who are one and the same, can't leave each other even if they want to. Hoeru and the others get caught up in the slapstick commotion of Knife & Cake and find out the dramatic story of their marriage...!

Meanwhile, Rikuo's relationship with Rei is discovered by the Gozyugers. Rikuo, who can no longer keep quiet, tells them about his past with Rei, and "The Calamity" awakens in the worst possible way...!?

videos.title: Choose Your World! The Ultimate Final Sword!
videos.overview: The Calamity Bellum and Rei have put the Gozyugers in a big pinch...! In response, the petrified "Final Sword" appears in front of Hoeru. As a test of the sword, Hoeru is asked by TegaSword to choose one of two worlds: the world he lives in now, or the world without TegaSword, where Hoeru is happy with his brother Hisamitsu, not his parents or "Kuon". TegaSword tells Hoeru, "If you choose the world without me, the Calamity will disappear." What will Hoeru choose at the crossroads of fate...!?

videos.title: Scattered Battle Scars, Gray Glow
videos.overview:
The Calamity has not only harmed Mr. Shining Knife & Mrs. Sweet Cake, but even TegaJune, leaving the Bridan trembling with rage. The Bridan commanders then make a decision...!

Meanwhile, Rikuo holds a "Thanks Party" to express his gratitude to everyone before the full-scale battle against the Calamity. He invites Hoeru and the others to his house, where he serves them a huge feast, and they all have a great time together.

Eventually, Rikuo decides to go to Rei alone...!?

videos.title: Transform!! You Too Can Become Younger
videos.overview:
One day, Kinjiro encounters a mysterious high school boy. His true identity is Genji Kaku, his childhood friend who has rejuvenated and become the ring warrior RyuRanger! Genji's competitive spirit toward Kinjiro burns as fiercely as ever, and before they can even celebrate their reunion, they agree to a three-match showdown for the ring. Watched over by judges like Hoeru, they clash fiercely in cooking, menko, and baseball.

As the rejuvenated grandpas battle in earnest, the Bridan suddenly barges in, plunging the situation into utter chaos...!

videos.title: It's Getting Wild, Rival! What is Youth!?
videos.overview:
Ever since his unresolved showdown with Genji, Kinjiro had been constantly pondering the meaning of "youth." Then, Trump No.1—who inherited the will of their fallen comrade—challenged Kinjiro and the Gozyugers to a hellish Trump No.1 Battle! And there, at the battle venue, was Genji himself...!?

This card battle is a deadly game where defeat means losing everything. Soon, Kinjiro and Genji revert to their original old man forms mid-battle, plunging them into a major crisis!

The once-valiant Genji quickly becomes despondent, muttering, "I can't do anything in this body..." Then, Kinjiro, now in Joji's form, makes an unexpected proposal to Trump No.1!

videos.title: Friendship Cross! Lord Kumade is a Fashionista
videos.overview:
Bouquet grows increasingly anxious as the Gozyugers keep getting stronger, and asks TegaJune to create a new Bridan. The newly born younger sister, Ribbon, wanders off alone somewhere in search of her beloved "lovely things"...!?

Meanwhile, Mashiro has become like a different person after losing his cherished robe he always wears. Amidst this, the Gozyugers face off against Fashion No.1 in a No.1 Battle. They all show off their special outfits, but...!?

videos.title: Judgment: Ring Hunter
videos.overview:
Why did Kuon become a Ring Hunter? Before him appeared a man who knew the answer to that mystery: Koyo Iwao. To Kuon, Koyo was a benefactor who looked after him and Hoeru in the No One World when they were children. Koyo, now a Ring Warrior, and Kuon engage in a fierce battle for the ring...!

The Gozyugers, who stumbled upon this battle between Kuon and Koyo, are suddenly attacked by Ribbon. Ribbon imprisons not only the Gozyugers and Koyo, but even Kuon himself in a mysterious prison! The Gozyugers and Kuon must now cooperate to escape...!?

videos.title: Burning Intensity! I'll Show You the Power of the Rings!
videos.overview: Until now, the Gozyugers have encountered various Universe Warriors and fought over the Sentai Rings. Now, Kazu Sekimoto, the passionate Toei producer who once made a documentary series following the Gozyugers, is making a comeback! Producer Sekimoto will once again follow the Gozyugers closely, uncovering the secrets of the Sentai Rings!?

videos.title: Terrifying! Ribbon Laughs in the Haunted House
videos.overview:
Because of Obakeyashiki No.1, TegaSword Village has turned into a haunted house! The town is in an uproar with people forced to play ghosts and others terrified. When the Gozyugers storm the House of Terror to restore the town, they find Bouquet and Ribbon there too. Separated from Ribbon, Bouquet trembles in fear of the ghosts, but fatefully reunites with her beloved Rikuo. Their sudden closeness creates a heart-pounding situation...!

Then, the Haunted House No.1 Battle begins. Rikuo, who brings smiles to everyone, rises to the challenge!

videos.title: The Final Key! Bouquet of Destruction and Creation No.1
videos.overview:
Her beloved idol, Rikuo, is the hateful GozyuLeon who defeated her sister, Ribbon. Burning with rage and sadness, Bouquet decides to abandon her name of "compassion" and avenge Ribbon. Meanwhile, even though Rikuo knows that Bouquet is his enemy, he regrets having hurt her, a fan. Ryugi begins to tell Rikuo about the first time they met...

Meanwhile, the "Final No.1" appears before Hoeru and the others. Confused by this mysterious No.1, completely different from the previous ones, Hoeru and the others challenge him to a No.1 Battle...!?

videos.title: Forever LIVE! A Bouquet for a Rikuonist
videos.overview:
GoodeBurn, abducted by the awakened TegaJune, is to be re-educated as the "Prince of Ruin, TegaNagure"... To save GoodeBurn, the Gozyugers also head to the No One World! While each battles the Bridan, Rikuo once again faces Bouquet, consumed by hatred. Though an idol and a fan, they are also enemies bound by a tragic fate that forces them to fight... Still, Rikuo tells Bouquet, "I want you to be happy."

Soon, an even more outrageous situation unfolds, and Kuon begins to move...!?

videos.title: Kuon's Decisive Battle! A Present From an Angel
videos.overview:
In the Christmas-themed TegaSword Village, the Gozyugers seem to be having fun. But only Hoeru looks gloomy, thinking about Kuon, who absorbed TegaJune. The brothers used to write wishes together happily at Christmas, but now they must fight as enemies. Hoeru and Kuon finally face off in their final showdown! Meanwhile, the other Gozyugers engage in fierce battles with the Bridan generals...!

At that moment, GoodeBurn recalls TegaJune's sorrowful expression in the No One World and wonders if there's anything he can do...!?

videos.title: I Am Red! An Original Sentai, Has Arrived!
videos.overview:
Amid the bustling New Year's crowds, a mysterious red warrior—Origa Red—appeared before Hoeru! This megaton-level fighter wielding origami was searching for Hoeru for some reason, and the two ended up battling...!

Meanwhile, the other Gozyugers were summoned by the person holding the final Sentai Ring, the Kakuranger Ring. Meanwhile, the members of Bridan each begin walking new paths, but only Fire Candle is dissatisfied with this situation...!?

videos.title: Matching Rings! All the Reds Stand by Their Comrades
videos.overview: Hoeru and the others find themselves in a major crisis when the Calamity, Vidal, is revived, but they manage to escape the situation. Sasuke, who witnessed the battle up close, challenges the Gozyugers to a "No.1 Yokai Battle," staking the Kakuranger Ring as the prize! Facing Sasuke, who declares, "The one I deem most yokai-like wins," the Gozyuger members each give their all to fully embody a yokai. However, only Hoeru is distracted, preoccupied with Origa Red's words: "You're unfit to be Red, unfit to be leader." Sasuke's words prompt Hoeru to reflect on "the reason I've pushed myself this far"... despite being unfit.

videos.title: Endless Youth! This is the True Path of a Party Person!
videos.overview:
Finally, all the rings have gathered among the Gozyugers, but only one person can have their wish granted. Therefore, the six decide to hold a Gozyuger Inner Ring Tournament, and the first battle is set between Kinjiro and Sumino! However, just before the fight, Kinjiro starts pondering his own wish: "What does it even mean to become a true party person!?" Mr. Shining Knife & Mrs. Sweet Cake try to resolve his dilemma, but...!?

Meanwhile, Fire Candle, having obtained the power of calamity, makes "a certain resolution" and begins to move...!

videos.title: GO FIGHT Rikuo! When the Hundred Nights End
videos.overview:
The second battle of the Gozyuger Inner Ring Tournament pits Rikuo against Ryugi! But with both fighters evenly matched, the contest ends in a stalemate... So Ryugi makes Rikuo a proposal. If Ryugi can become Rikuo's producer and fulfill his wish to "return to being the number one idol," he gets the ring.

Immediately, idol producer Ryugi launches the "Over-the-Top Rikuo Byakuya Production Strategy," a collaboration with TegaSword. However, Bouquet, the self-proclaimed top Rikuonist, can't stand idly by and watch this strategy unfold. She steps forward to declare her own production plans, sparking a rivalry with Ryugi...!

videos.title: Resolve to Reform the World! In the Winds of Calamity
videos.overview:
Before the ring battle with Hoeru, Mashiro is told by Rex, the boss of the calamity group Cladis, "Become a god!" Mashiro's wish to "become a god surpassing TegaSword" is granted, but it leads to humanity's extinction... Naturally rejecting such a proposal, Mashiro confronts Hoeru and Rex, but is completely outmatched. Then, Fire Candle bursts in, plunging the Gozyugers into an absolute crisis...

Amidst the heart-wrenching cry of GoodeBurn, "Don't go, Kumade!", Mashiro's "world-saving act of resolve" begins...!

videos.title: We Are, No.1 Sentai Gozyuger!
videos.overview: In an unexpected turn of events, Hoeru becomes the top contender in the ring battle. Before him, Fire Candle reappears. His purpose, of course, was to settle their fated battle. Fighting fiercely like beasts, Hoeru recalled the days spent with the Gozyuger members. What did Rikuo, Ryugi, Kinjiro, Sumino, and Mashiro mean to him, someone who had always lived as an outcast? What did he truly desire beyond the fight? Having found the answer, Hoeru finally confesses his wish to Tega Sword!
